sources.coverage: Country-specific last-name column indexed from 2019 locatefamily.com geographic listings and published by SajjadPourali/Surnames; does not claim national coverage.

Upstream data rights unclear despite the mirror's MIT license. Research only.

sources.territory: Mali: Bambara-language clan-name dictionary, with Mali-specific locales and neighboring-language notes; not a national population register
sources.coverage: 393 distinct \lx entries of clan names labeled \gf NOM.CL in Bamadaba jamuw v0.3, including Bambara/Dogon/Soninké/Peul/Malinké traditions. When present, published French or Latin spelling variants are preferred; one name per clan entry, aliases checked for duplicates.
sources.limitations: A clan-name lexicon is not direct person-level proof of Malian nationality or current residence. Some groups are transnational; tonal Bambara orthography differs from civil-register French spelling. Dictionary described as CC BY-NC-SA; noncommercial/sharealike conditions require licence review before reuse; research only.

sources.territory: Mali-centered family-name collection, grouped by Dogon, Soninké, Bozo, Bambara and other communities; explicit foreign-country labels excluded
sources.coverage: Published names of families with source-provided community/ethnic labels. Only single attested value spellings, not slash-separated synonyms, interpreted as names; no invented forms.
sources.limitations: Community labels are not proof of Malian citizenship/residence of a specific bearer. Cross-border communities may be represented. Author's database gives no independently verified sampling methodology or explicit dataset licence. Manual person-level audit and redistribution-rights clearance mandatory; research only.
